newsitem.title: USA: ComEd again shuts 789 MW Ill. power plant.
newsitem.headline: ComEd again shuts 789 MW Ill. power plant.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities nuclear power unit 1 in Cordova, Ill., was shut for repairs Monday during a failed attempt to restart the unit, a company spokesman said.

"It has been taken off line for work on the main steam isolation valve," spokesman Gary Wald said Tuesday, adding it likely would be "a couple of days," before the unit again goes into the restart mode.
Quad Cities 1 was restarting from a scheduled refueling outage which began February 10.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
